analysis: Supplementary exploratory offline analyses addressing P0-4 and P0-5

retrieval.representation: Morgan radius2/2048 bits, no chirality, binary cosine (original M ranking)
retrieval.common_filter: valid canonical molecule; exact seed RC minus 1; exclude seed; single component required for returned library molecules
retrieval.reference_copy_rule: A direct-library baseline may return supplied exemplars; it is not judged by the generative non-exemplar-copy rule
retrieval.QED_ties: SA_raw ascending, then canonical SMILES ascending
retrieval.output_count: one deterministic output per target per baseline; never treated as five independent replicas

structures.tanimoto: Original parent-form radius2/2048-bit Morgan Tanimoto, matched to paper; organic-component sensitivity also retained
structures.MCS: Maximum common connected substructure, maximize atoms; compare elements and bond orders; permit ring-to-chain matches; no chirality or formal-charge matching
structures.MCS_form: Unique carbon-containing component after removal of atomic counterions; input charges and stereochemical specification retained
structures.MCS_fraction: number of common heavy atoms divided by seed organic-component heavy atoms; candidate-normalized fraction also saved
structures.incomplete_MCS: Record lower bound and completion flag. Primary exact MCS summaries require completion; incomplete gates report unresolved cases and conservative lower-bound acceptance.
gate_policies: filter the originally selected final molecule
reselect from all saved eligible union candidates
structures.replay: Same last-occurrence canonical deduplication, QED/SA/canonical selector as original; no new proposals
structures.size: Both original parent-form and organic-component MW/heavy-atom differences; organic logP/TPSA/HBD/HBA changes

statistics.unit: 25 equally weighted paired target means; five original planned positions per LLM target; one deterministic library output per target
statistics.yield_definition: QED for accepted output, zero for no delivery; planned denominator retained under every gate
statistics.new_test_family: Nine exploratory QED-yield contrasts: T/M/G minus each of three direct-retrieval baselines; Holm across nine
statistics.sign_flip: 100000 paired target sign flips, seed42, two-sided plus-one correction
statistics.threshold_curves: Descriptive sensitivity analyses, not new-generation causal ablations or universal chemical acceptability thresholds

molecular_novelty: Exact canonical and stereo-agnostic library membership, plus exact canonical original-triplet training membership; not novelty against all chemistry or LLM training
